changes.detail: After EmailHelper.parseEmail, added: if (!email) return callback(new Error('OIDC profile did not contain a required email claim')). Guard runs before User.findOne and before the createNewUser path. Removed the `email || ''` fallback in the createNewUser call (now `email: email`) since the guard guarantees non-null. This prevents the TypeError in UserCreator.mjs (`user.email.split('@')[1]` on empty string).

Split the single compound condition into two independent ifs: $set.email applied whenever email && email !== user.email (IdP email always becomes primary); $push.emails applied only when additionally !user.emails.some(e => e.email === email) (no duplicate secondary).

added: should callback with an error and not create a user when the profile has no email
should promote the IdP email to primary without duplicating it in emails when it is already a secondary
should set the primary email and push a new secondary when the IdP email is unknown
should pass the IdP email to createNewUser for a new user
